summary: Recent developments highlight tensions over D.C.'s autonomy across multiple domains, from control of federal buildings to budget decisions and deployment of military forces within the District. A senator has pledged to prioritize statehood legislation, while advocacy groups continue linking D.C.'s limited self-governance to incidents including a federal takeover and National Guard deployment. Without statehood, Congress retains the power to override D.C.'s local laws, control its budget spending, and deploy federal military forces within the District's borders without local consent.
